Title: Mutations in Fruit Flies — Part 2
Content: The student wants to understand how the mutations of the common fruit fly are passed to other generations. The student performs a simulation in which a typical fly breeds with a fruit fly that has a mutation. The mutated fly has curly wings.
Figure `2` shows the results of Cross `#1` of the simulation.
The student uses the simulator to do another cross between `text(two)` of the mutant offspring.
Figure `3` shows the results of Cross `#2` of the simulation.
The student uses the simulator to do another cross between `text(two)` of the typical offspring from Cross `#1`.
Figure `4` shows the results of Cross `#3` of the simulation.
